title: Health-Tag Prediction
description: This project predicts whether a recipe will be labeled “healthy” using features like ingredients, cooking time, and nutrition. It shows how data can help users quickly find healthier options.

title: Nutrient Composition
description: This project visualizes how nutrient composition changes as food processing increases, highlighting that fiber makes up a smaller proportion in more processed foods.

title: Data Center Energy Usage Analysis
description: This project analyzes the energy usage of data centers located in Virginia. It tracks change of energy consumption over time in relation to when data centers were built in specific zipcodes.

title: N-Gram Language Model
description: This project builds language models (uniform, unigram, and n-gram) to learn patterns in text and generate new sentences based on probabilities. It shows how tokenization and statistical modeling can capture language structure and predict realistic word sequences.

title: Bike Traffic Flow Visualization
description: This interactive visualization maps Bluebikes traffic patterns across the Boston and Cambridge area using Mapbox and D3.js. The project analyzes over 260,000 bike trips from March 2024, displaying station traffic volume through circle size and traffic flow direction through color. Users can explore how bike activity changes throughout the day using a time-based filter slider and dynamic map interactions.
